entities.name: Shabnam Ghani Lone
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Shabnum Gani Lone is an Indian Kashmiri woman analyst, politician and lawyer at Supreme Court of India. She is the younger daughter of Abdul Ghani Lone, a separatist leader who was killed in a rally in Srinagar in 2002.
